```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML, display
from site_helpers import meta

m = meta()
b, g, d, v = m["btc"], m["gold"], m["dca"], m["vg"]
asof = max(b["asof"], g["asof"], d["asof"])
from site_helpers import VG_STRENGTH
v_pill = ('<span class="pill flat">FLAT</span>' if v["position"] == 0 else
          f'<span class="pill ls">{"LONG VALUE" if v["position"] > 0 else "LONG GROWTH"}</span>')

def pill(p):
    if p >= 0.999: return '<span class="pill long">LONG</span>'
    if p > 0:      return f'<span class="pill partial">PARTIAL {p:.0%}</span>'
    return '<span class="pill flat">FLAT</span>'

c = m["core"]
c_build = " + ".join(f'{x["weight"]:.0%}' for x in c["construction"])
from site_helpers import load_backtest, perf_stats
c_cagr = perf_stats(load_backtest("core")["portfolio"], 252)["CAGR"]

btc_regime = {"b": "Bullish", "bn": "Bullish-neutral", "n": "Neutral", "sn": "Bearish-neutral", "s": "Bearish"}[b["regime"]]

display(HTML(f"""
<div class="hero">
  <h1>Alpine Quantamental Investment</h1>
  <p>Alpine Quantamental Investment is a systematic macro investment platform that pursues market-neutral
  strategies across global asset classes. Our process combines quantitative signal research with fundamental
  macroeconomic analysis to generate returns uncorrelated with broader market direction.</p>
  <span class="asof-pill">Signals as of {asof}</span>
</div>

<div class="cards cards-2x2">
  <a class="card-s featured" href="strategies/core.qmd">
    <span class="k">Multi-asset · core + overlays</span>
    <span class="t">Core Portfolio</span>
    <span class="pill ls">{c_build}</span>
    <span class="d">Passive core plus equity rotation, gold and bitcoin overlays · backtest CAGR <b>{c_cagr:+.1%}</b></span>
    <span class="go">Construction & performance →</span>
  </a>
  <a class="card-s" href="strategies/dca.qmd">
    <span class="k">Equities · long / short</span>
    <span class="t">Global Equity Rotation</span>
    <span class="pill ls">{len(d['longs'])} LONG · {len(d['shorts'])} SHORT</span>
    <span class="d">Top long: <b>{', '.join(d['longs'][:3])}</b><br>Top short: <b>{', '.join(d['shorts'][-3:][::-1])}</b></span>
    <span class="go">Signals & backtest →</span>
  </a>
  <a class="card-s" href="strategies/value_growth.qmd">
    <span class="k">US equity styles · absolute return</span>
    <span class="t">Value-Growth Rotation</span>
    {v_pill}
    <span class="d">{VG_STRENGTH[round(v['trend_score'] * 2) / 2]} · month-end signal {v['asof']}</span>
    <span class="go">Signals & backtest →</span>
  </a>
  <a class="card-s" href="strategies/gold.qmd">
    <span class="k">Gold · long / flat</span>
    <span class="t">Gold Trend</span>
    {pill(g['position'])}
    <span class="d">Gold {g['price']:,.0f} · regime: {g['regime'].replace('_', '-')}</span>
    <span class="go">Signals & backtest →</span>
  </a>
  <a class="card-s" href="strategies/btc.qmd">
    <span class="k">Crypto · long / flat</span>
    <span class="t">Bitcoin Trend</span>
    {pill(b['position'])}
    <span class="d">BTC {b['price']:,.0f} · regime: {btc_regime}</span>
    <span class="go">Signals & backtest →</span>
  </a>
</div>
"""))
```
